# HTTP and WebSocket reference

119 HTTP operations and 2 WebSockets, in 18 areas, generated from the Grove's OpenAPI document and its route handlers. Start with the [overview](../../API.md) for sign-in, roles, errors and the WebSocket protocols.

The OpenAPI document types no successful response, so each one is read from its handler. Of the 119 HTTP operations, 118 have their response shape read from the source, and for 1 the reference shows the expression the handler returns (marked "returned as is") next to a link to the handler.

| Area | Prefix | Operations | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`app`](app.md) | top level | 4 | The routes outside the routers: the Grove's health, its source code offer, and the members' page and published website at every other address. |
| [`admin`](admin.md) | `/api/admin` | 8 | Running the Grove: its people, their Grove-wide roles and who looks after the website, who may start spaces, who can find Public chat's room, and the activity log. |
| [`auth`](auth.md) | `/api/auth` | 7 | Accounts and sign-in: the host's first account (with the installer's setup code), joining by invitation, sessions kept in a cookie, password changes and host-given reset codes, and the Grove-wide roles the other routers check: the host, Grove owners and managers, webmasters, and members. |
| [`brand`](brand.md) | `/api/brand` | 11 | A Grove's identity: its name and words, colours, type, corners, logo and login picture. |
| [`chat`](chat.md) | `/api/chat` | 1 | Public chat: every member's way into this Grove's IRC room (GROVE_CHAT_CHANNEL). |
| [`editor`](editor.md) | `/api/community` | 6 | Small text edits with versions, drafts kept as people type, and short-lived, cookie-free website previews. |
| [`files`](files.md) | `/api/community` | 13 | The file bank: each space's shared files and folders, kept on this server. |
| [`grove`](grove.md) | `/api/grove` | 5 | Owner tools. |
| [`irc`](irc.md) | `/api/irc` | 3 | The host's own IRC: the connection settings and a WebSocket relay between the IRC page and the IRC server (host only, and only while the host's tools are on). |
| [`mail`](mail.md) | `/api/mail` | 6 | The host's mail: their mailbox over IMAP and SMTP, or a local Thunderbird profile, for the Mail page (host only, and only while the host's tools are on). |
| [`messages`](messages.md) | `/api/messages` | 16 | Messages: private conversations between two members, with photos and files. |
| [`routes`](routes.md) | `/api/community` | 19 | Spaces: their members and roles, invitations and public links, and the items written in them (board posts, notes, tasks, events, chat, lists, list items and comments), with live change notices and export. |
| [`setup`](setup.md) | `/api/grove-setup` | 3 | The host moves their Grove to their own domain from Settings. |
| [`site_notes`](site_notes.md) | `/api/webmaster` | 5 | Notes on the Grove's websites: anyone who can preview a site points at a spot on a page and says what should change there, or suggests new wording; its owners and webmasters reply, make the change and mark the note done. |
| [`webmaster`](webmaster.md) | `/api/webmaster` | 4 | Webmaster tools: bring a website into the file bank, to change it there and publish it. |
| [`website`](website.md) | `/api/webmaster` | 6 | The Grove's website: the pages visitors see at its address, published from a folder in Files. |
| [`wishes`](wishes.md) | `/api/wishes` | 1 | The wish lamp: anyone in the Grove asks for something they want in it. |
| [`workspace_setup`](workspace_setup.md) | `/api/community` | 3 | Owner-applied workspace kits; additions and receipt commit together exactly once. |
